headline: Markets closed for Diwali-Balipratipada; Sensex and Nifty closed at eight-month highs in last session

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Indian stock exchanges NSE and BSE are closed on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, due to Diwali-Balipratipada.
Normal trading activity in domestic stock markets will resume on Wednesday, 11 November.
In the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty extended gains to close at their highest levels in over eight months.
Volatility gauge India VIX has jumped 68% over three weeks despite a 7% rally in benchmark indices.
whatHappening: NSE and BSE remain shut for trading today on account of local holiday Diwali-Balipratipada.
On the last trading day, domestic equity indices rallied to achieve multi-month highs.
India VIX saw a sharp rise of 68% in three weeks alongside gains in Sensex and Nifty.
Strait of Hormuz LNG traffic hit its highest level in October according to recent global energy updates.
summary: Indian equity markets are closed today, 10 November 2026, on account of Diwali-Balipratipada, with trading scheduled to reopen on Wednesday. In the last session, Sensex and Nifty rallied to close at their highest levels in over eight months. Additionally, India VIX surged 68% over the past three weeks despite strong benchmark index gains.
